label: Next.js

structure.rule: Server Components by default; `'use client'` only where state or browser APIs are needed
no data fetching; props in, markup out

structure.responsibility: domain logic, data access, service facades
structure.rule: framework-free; the only place that talks to the data store

structure.responsibility: tests next to the code they cover

notes: Server Components by default; client components opt in with `'use client'` and stay leaf-sized.
Secrets are read in server code only; a variable reaches the browser only with the `NEXT_PUBLIC_` prefix.
Route handlers validate every request body at the boundary and return typed errors.
`npx tsc --noEmit` at 0 errors and `npm run lint` clean before a task is done.
